method: Built-in image_gen; photographic refinement of the existing catalog image
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: square catalog product photograph, Northstar Half Rack.
Input image 1 is the edit target and product identity reference. Create a more convincingly photographic version of this exact product, preserving its silhouette, proportions, component count and positions, graphite-and-orange color scheme, front three-quarter camera angle and square composition. Exactly two tall perforated uprights, open front, top crossmember and straight pull-up bar, two orange J-cups, two long orange spotter arms with black protective strips and raised end lips, two floor rails on four foot pads, rear diagonal braces and low crossmember. Keep all parts mechanically coherent and preserve the original equipment design. Do not add accessories or change the frame.
Photographic treatment: premium real-world studio product photograph shot with a full-frame camera and 70mm lens, crisp natural detail throughout the product. Replace the synthetic rendered look with restrained fine-grain graphite powder coat, natural orange painted steel with subtle surface variation, plausible weld beads at existing steel joints, sharp manufactured edges with tiny realistic edge radii, zinc-plated hex bolts and washers with controlled metallic highlights, matte black UHMW liners and textured rubber feet. Product is new and clean, without rust, dirt or exaggerated wear. Physically plausible hole interiors and contact between components. Soft large studio key light from upper left, gentle fill, natural tonal falloff across steel faces, grounded contact shadows under feet and a delicate floor shadow. Neutral warm-white seamless cyclorama with barely visible tonal gradient; avoid noisy or mottled background. Full rack visible with comfortable margins, centered. Keep orange restrained, avoid oversaturation. No text, branding, labels, dimensions, watermark, people, weights, bench, barbell, extra posts, duplicate parts, gym background, glossy plastic appearance, illustration, excessive HDR or artificial sharpening. Output one high-resolution square image.
review: Visually inspected: original open two-upright silhouette, orange attachments, floor rails, framing and clean studio background retained. Subtle material and lighting refinement. AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a manufactured product.
status: Alternative preview saved alongside the current catalog image; application references unchanged.
